title: Spiced Fregola Pilaf
description: A flavorful and aromatic pilaf dish from the Indian subcontinent, made with fregola and a blend of warming spices.

ingredients.name: Lightly spiced Indian pilaf spice blend

instructions: Heat the oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the red bell pepper and cook for 2 minutes.
Add the fregola and cook for 1-2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Add the pilaf spice blend and stir to combine.
Add 2 cups water to the saucepan and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for 15-20 minutes, or until the fregola is tender.
Fluff the pilaf with a fork and stir in the cilantro, salt, and lemon juice.
